scenarios.title: Daily checklist
scenarios.taskBrief: Prepare three cards: review today’s support queue; check sandbox credentials; send the daily status summary. Review each card before marking it confirmed or rejected.

completionBoundaryByMethod.manual: All three expected checklist cards are reviewed and explicitly confirmed or rejected; no external work is executed.
completionBoundaryByMethod.routine-template: Create a run from Daily Work Checklist, review all three cards and metadata, then explicitly confirm or reject each item; no external work is executed.
completionBoundaryByMethod.encrypted-collaboration: Complete the reviewed encrypted request/import/reply/merge round trip in a second local browser profile; review all three cards and the final assignment state; no external work is executed.

scenarios.title: Meeting follow-up
scenarios.taskBrief: After the vendor meeting, prepare a card to summarize decisions, a task to confirm the renewal date, and an English follow-up email draft to Alex. Do not send the email.

completionBoundaryByMethod.manual: Review all three cards and the no-send restriction; keep the email as a draft and explicitly confirm or reject each card.
completionBoundaryByMethod.routine-template: Create a Meeting Follow-up run, review cards and metadata, preserve the no-send restriction, then explicitly confirm or reject each routine item.
completionBoundaryByMethod.encrypted-collaboration: Complete the reviewed encrypted request/import/reply/merge round trip in a second local browser profile; review all cards and verify the email remains a draft and unsent.

scenarios.title: Shift handover
scenarios.taskBrief: Prepare a handover card to review the overnight queue, a card to check access logs, and a card to close the incident after the access logs are checked. Do not grant production access.

completionBoundaryByMethod.manual: Review all three cards, preserve the do-not-grant-production-access restriction and the prerequisite direction, then explicitly confirm or reject each card.
completionBoundaryByMethod.routine-template: Create a Shift Handover run, review all three cards, metadata and prerequisite direction, then explicitly confirm or reject each routine item.
completionBoundaryByMethod.encrypted-collaboration: Complete the reviewed encrypted request/import/reply/merge round trip in a second local browser profile; verify the prerequisite direction and access restriction remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: Software release review
scenarios.taskBrief: Prepare a card to run the release test suite, a card to review the changelog, and a task to request release approval. Do not deploy to production.

completionBoundaryByMethod.manual: Review all cards and preserve the production prohibition, then explicitly confirm or reject each card; do not deploy.
completionBoundaryByMethod.routine-template: Create a Software Testing / Release Review run, review cards and metadata, preserve the production prohibition, then confirm or reject routine items.
completionBoundaryByMethod.encrypted-collaboration: Complete the reviewed encrypted request/import/reply/merge round trip in a second local browser profile; recheck that no deployment action or confirmation was inherited.
